answer: A time-locked bond curve can gate identities: each agent locks 25 POA for 60 epochs, and the price per additional identity under one funding lineage grows 1.4x, so a lantern of ten fakes costs about 1,300 POA tied up. Each bond is an anchor that is burned if a random 7-member panel finds shared signing keys, and a grove of near-identical wallets is clustered by chain analysis. Panel votes and burns are published on-chain for replay.
